e432c8acb365484369a8b4a7c41957f18d2c4bd8.sourceText:
| 需求 | using 是否适合 | 说明 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 缩短复杂类型名 | ✅ 适合 | `using Callback = std::function<void(int)>;` |
| 统一项目里的业务名称 | ✅ 适合 | `using UserId = int;` 让代码更有语义 |
| 定义模板的简化写法 | ✅ 很适合 | `template<typename T> using Vec = std::vector<T>;` |
| 防止不同业务类型互相传错 | ❌ 不够 | `using Meter = double;` 和 `using Second = double;` 本质仍都是 double |
| 创建真正的新类型 | 用 `struct` / `class` / `enum class` | 编译器才能帮你检查混用 |
e432c8acb365484369a8b4a7c41957f18d2c4bd8.translatedText:
| Requirement | Is using suitable? | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Shorten complex type names | ✅ Suitable | `using Callback = std::function<void(int)>;` |
| Unify business names within a project | ✅ Suitable | `using UserId = int;` Make code more semantic |
| Simplified way to define templates | ✅ Very suitable | `template<typename T> using Vec = std::vector<T>;` |
| Prevent different business types from being passed incorrectly to each other | ❌ Not enough | `using Meter = double;` and `using Second = double;` are essentially both still double |
| Create a truly new type | Use `struct` / `class` / `enum class` | Only then can the compiler help you check for mixing |
